# Copilot Hooks

This directory is a scaffold for GitHub Copilot hook definitions.

## What belongs here

Hooks allow you to intercept specific Copilot events (e.g. before a PR is opened, after a test run) and inject custom logic or context.

## Status

Deferred — hook design will be addressed in a dedicated session.
